name: Karnu Glass Horizon
loreTies: Sacred order channels solar power into civilization.
Solar Law: coordinated Titans gain defensive clarity after holding objectives.
Karnu Glass Horizon is a colossal Aten Ra Titan shaped by sacred order channels solar power into civilization. It manifests the Realm's law through battlefield-scale mythic force.
shortBackstory: Karnu Glass Horizon is the long sight of the solar barque: he reads enemies where sky, river, and desert meet. Human obelisks and horizon sanctuaries are static imitations of his living range geometry.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Karnu Glass Horizon began as more than a weapon in The Golden Dominion of Aten. Karnu Glass Horizon was bound to a solar pylon during a Gate disturbance that tested whether sacred order channels solar power into civilization could survive contact with the Hollow. The title carried in their name was earned when the Titan chose duty over spectacle and accepted a burden ordinary soldiers could not survive.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Aten Ra, Karnu Glass Horizon is treated as proof that a divine solar civilization of judgment, radiance, command, sacred order, temple law, and ancient solar mathematics can become battlefield doctrine without losing its soul. Their silhouette carries gold, bronze, sacred geometry, solar light, obsidian enamel, amber radiance, pyramid-pylon armor forms, but their real identity is tactical: defensive command, radiant control, judgment zones, solar sustain. Every deployment makes faction philosophy visible through movement, restraint, and force.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Gate did not simply attack Karnu Glass Horizon; it tried to measure what their Realm values most. The wound echoed sacred doctrine back as bait, tempting the Titan to overextend, break battle line, or turn culture into raw fuel. Karnu Glass Horizon survived by refusing the Gate's terms, leaving a scar that still reacts whenever judgment zones appears on the map.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In The First Reopening, Karnu Glass Horizon gives the campaign a personal lens on faction survival. Their presence reinforces the rule that faction identity stays distinct unless a mission explicitly permits otherwise. In a one-active-Titan Titan, Karnu Glass Horizon turns Solar Law from a passive rule into a story statement: the Realm is defending its meaning.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Karnu Glass Horizon's flaw is overcommitment to the belief that their Realm's answer must always be enough. NPC witnesses and rival factions challenge that certainty as the Hollow learns to imitate law, oath, balance, life, radiance, and ambition without understanding any of them. Their battlefield stats support this arc: HP 30, attack 8, range 2, speed 3, energy 3.

relationshipHooks: Mesha and other Codex witnesses can interpret their Gate scar.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
mythicSource: Solar barque horizon + desert glass + long-range Ra sight
visualCanon: Artillery Titan with sweeping solar-barge shoulder arcs, desert-glass lens organs, falcon-eye targeting visor, bronze horizon vanes, lapis braces, and mirage-light cannon geometry grown from the body. Avoid sci-fi sniper/mech; every range element should feel like sacred astronomy made alive.
